WITH risky_traders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.tradereg
    FROM trader t
    JOIN transactionrecord tr ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
    WHERE 
      -- High-Risk Trader Profile
      ((CAST(t.trading_performance->'risklevel'->>'levratio')::numeric > 5.0 
       AND t.trading_performance->'risklevel'->>'risklevel' = 'Aggressive')
      OR 
      (t.voldaily / t.acctbal > 0.5))
      AND
      -- Market Manipulation Pattern: Layering/Spoofing
      ((tr.risk_indicators->>'layerind') = 'Confirmed'
       OR 
       ((tr.risk_indicators->>'spoofprob')::numeric > 0.75 
        AND (tr.modfreq / (1 - tr.cancelpct)) > 1.0)
)
SELECT AVG(ab.patsim - ab.peercorr) as avg_pas_raw
FROM advancedbehavior ab
JOIN risky_traders rt ON ab.translink IN (
    SELECT tr.transreg FROM transactionrecord tr WHERE tr.trdref = rt.tradereg
);
